## LQ v2 Notification Dispatcher (v2.0.0)
Every minute:
1. lq_v2_claim_notifications: expired leases -> uncertain; lease due pending rows; claim due uncertain rows for reconciliation.
2. send: chat.postMessage with metadata {notification_id}. Result classified as sent / retryable / permanent / uncertain and recorded with the Slack receipt.
3. reconcile: conversations.history searched by metadata. found -> sent. not found -> requeue. inconclusive -> retry, then operator.

If a Slack call gets no response at all (timeout, network), the run fails, ops is alerted, and the lease expiry marks the row uncertain so reconciliation decides. No n8n auto-retry: retries are scheduled by the database.
Contract: docs/v2/delivery-contract.md

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: $json.channel, text: $json.text, unfurl_links: false, unfurl_media: false, metadata: { event_type: 'lq_v2_notification', event_payload: { notification_id: $json.notification_id, correlation_id: $json.correlation_id } } }) }}
